title: About Labrity
intro: Labrity is a web studio based in Münster, Germany. The owner is Andreas Tonn.

sections.title: Where we work
sections.text: Labrity is based in Münster and works with businesses across North Rhine-Westphalia and throughout Germany. Consultation and implementation take place conveniently online.

sections.title: Our approach
sections.text: Every website is created around the business, audience and positioning — without generic templates. Structure, design, trust, SEO and the user journey are developed as one connected system.

sections.title: Technology and languages
sections.text: We work with modern technologies such as Next.js and React. This website is available in German, English, Russian and Ukrainian.
